pm_active.meaning: executeHedge is invoked while PM (precompile module) is active

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: BLP has an active reserve for the spot asset token

accounting_reads_revert.meaning: totalBackingSigned, surplus, distributableSurplus and settleDailyPnL gate 3 accounting reads revert

assumptions: executeHedge is the operation that registers the spot asset in vaultSupplied via notifyVaultSupply.
The accounting reads (totalBackingSigned, surplus, distributableSurplus, settleDailyPnL gate 3) are the reads whose completion is required.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call executeHedge or whether the caller is unauthorized; the applicability scope of the requirement is limited to the PM-active, no-reserve scenario.

limitations: Formalizes only the accounting_reads_revert impact; the suppliedBalance revert and permanent bricking are separate impacts handled in other passes.
The no-reserve condition is represented as a Boolean because the report gives no numeric reserve definition.
